promotion_rule.controlled_test_order: May validate plumbing and evidence capture but never counts as realized revenue or Final Net Profit.
promotion_rule.real_non_test_order: Required before a pair can become FINAL_NET_PROFIT_VERIFIED.
promotion_rule.final_profit_formula: customer gross - supplier final payable - supplier shipping - payment fee - tax/import borne by HUNT - FX cost - discount cost - attributed marketing cost - realized returns/refunds/cancellations - other variable cost
promotion_rule.unknown_rule: Any missing required cost input keeps Final Net Profit UNKNOWN.
